# Maria Oyinlola Limited — mol.oagroupng.com

Maria Oyinlola Limited (MOL) is the financial services arm of OA Group Nigeria — a CBN-regulated financial institution providing credit and lending, investment and asset management, financial advisory, digital financing, agency banking, and corporate finance services to Nigerian individuals, SMEs, corporates, and institutions.

## Company

- Type: CBN-regulated financial services company
- Registered in Nigeria (CAC RC: [CAC: RC-XXXXXX])
- CBN Licence: [CBN LICENCE: RC-XXXXXX]
- Address: 4, Aderoju Adewuyi Street, Off Alfred Olaiya Street, Opebi-Ikeja, Lagos State, Nigeria
- Phone: +234 806 165 0349
- Email: info@mol.oagroupng.com
- Group: A Member of OA Group Nigeria (oagroupng.com)

## Products

- Credit & Lending: personal loans, SME working capital, business development loans, payroll financing
- Investment & Asset Management: fixed income portfolios, growth portfolios, corporate treasury
- Financial Advisory: personal financial planning, SME structuring, corporate treasury advisory
- Digital Financing: technology-enabled financing, digital onboarding, mobile finance
- Agency Banking: agent partnerships for entrepreneurs and institutions
- Corporate & Institutional Finance: treasury management, payment distribution, institutional credit

## Key Information

- Regulatory: CBN regulated. Clients should verify regulatory status at cbn.gov.ng
- Investment products carry risk. Returns not guaranteed. Capital at risk.
- AML/KYC requirements apply to all clients
- Data processed in accordance with NDPR 2019 and NDPA 2023

## OA Group Ecosystem

MOL is the financing engine of OA Group Nigeria. Cross-referrals: Henrisol Properties (property vehicles for investment clients), OA Consulting (working capital for consulting implementations), Pearl Primus (project financing).
